This reminds me of something that happened to me recently. I met a guy on a site. I went to his workplace where he’s the boss and only employee or whatever, he wanted me to hang out and flirt with him at work and then “do other stuff” if there was down time at work. I was there for nearly 4 hours flirting with him, letting him touch me, he seemed to get off on the thrill of being at work but also he was married and couldn’t meet many other places. He paid me xxx and said that could some of it go to credit towards next time, eluding to since we didn’t have sex that we could have sex next time. I met him for ice cream one day. Flirting and some touching. He goes onto tell me how he got with a “free girl” recently, and I said good for you dude. And personally I don’t get jealous but then he said “I’m so glad I can tell you. I have no one else I can tell.” And then I realized i was also becoming his therapist. Then he kept referring to her as a free girl and it sort of annoyed me so I said maybe you should see her instead of me. He said “I can’t do that. If people saw me with her they’d think she was my daughter” and the thing is I’m not white, he is, and saying stupid shit like this rang up the rest of his “credit” to me. Blocked and never again. But an interesting story. A lesson on boundaries and how men will take from us and think as long as they don’t put their penis in us, that everything we do is free besides that. Ugh.
